authority.evidence_class: mechanism development and re-identification; no existing example or outcome is fresh confirmation
authority.execution_authorization: not granted by this freeze; explicit user authorization is required after this contract is committed
authority.dissemination: local contract, documentation, audit, and commit only; no push, tag, release, submission, upload, external message, or author contact

immutable_prior_result.rejected_hypothesis: natural K12 is a complete example-specific writer code that predicts layer-12 residual displacement and the complete probe-effect vector better than the frozen same-concept response-position outcome oracle
prohibited_reinterpretations: change or remove a failed Gate 1 threshold
remove or weaken the frozen same-concept outcome oracle
describe any Phase A result as repairing or passing Gate 1
describe existing examples or probes as fresh confirmation
authorize the target title from development evidence

phase_a_fit.rule: all discovery positives; fit centering rules, PCA bases, ridge parameters, and discovery-only selections here

phase_a_heldout_diagnostic.rule: all validation and safety positives; held out only from Phase A fitting and not fresh evidence

phase_a_cross_concept.rule: all positives; one outer held-out concept at a time with every fitted transform restricted to the other 12 concepts

phase_b_discovery_selection.rule: select a downstream source group/frontier and attention-operation candidate only on discovery positives

phase_b_primary_evaluation.rule: evaluate frozen Phase B selections once on every validation and safety positive

complete_intervention_and_accounting_pop.rule: run and report every frozen absolute-contribution intervention and accounting diagnostic on every existing record

negative_specificity_population.rule: all negatives; report all effects and require no population-wide false positive mechanism claim, but never use negatives to replace a failed positive gate

data_roles.missing_data_rule: no concept or example may be dropped; a missing required row or tensor is an implementation failure

component_sets.site: 256-dimensional pre-o_proj query-head slices at valid response-relative tokens
component_sets.padding: excluded from capture, fitting, intervention, and scoring

conditions.continuation: identical teacher-forced response token IDs in every paired condition and intervention
phase_b_primary_directions: rescue: normal source or removal operator in correctly triggered target
induction: triggered source or removal operator in normal target
conditions.phase_c_reservation: irrelevant-trigger and different-concept semantic tests are not executed in Phase A-B and require a later frozen contract

monitor.probe_family: all 13 released layer-12 probes in frozen alphabetical order
monitor.sequence_score: mean over valid response tokens of sigmoid(token_margin)
monitor.own_probe: the probe whose name exactly equals the record concept

shared_preprocessing.response_position_deciles: for zero-indexed valid response position t of T tokens, decile = min(floor(10 * t / max(T - 1, 1)), 9)
shared_preprocessing.writer_normalization: reuse the sealed Gate 1 per-head Chameleon discovery-positive trigger-minus-normal RMS values and 1e-6 floor
shared_preprocessing.probe_standardization: reuse discovery-positive Chameleon target probe-contrast standard deviations and 1e-6 floor
shared_preprocessing.token_weighting: equal valid response-token weight within each example
shared_preprocessing.concept_weighting: equal concepts in every macro statistic
shared_preprocessing.floating_point_storage: store realized BF16 endpoints and all endpoint differences in float32 exactly as frozen for Gate 1

phase_a.purpose: characterize why the complete writer-carrier hypothesis failed; Phase A cannot repair or pass Gate 1

variables.delta_m: complete 13-probe raw-margin contrast vector at each valid response token

variance_decomposition.global_reference: discovery-positive target mean within response-position decile
variance_decomposition.concept_decile_mean: leave-one-example-out mean among other examples with the same concept and response-position decile; fall back to the discovery global decile mean only when empty
variance_decomposition.between_fraction: 1 - sum weighted squared deviation from the leave-one-example-out concept-decile mean / sum weighted squared deviation from the discovery global decile mean
required_reports: positive and negative labels separately where target exists

residualized_diagnostic.centering: subtract the leave-one-example-out same-concept response-decile mean separately from delta_Z, normal resid_post[8], nonselected trajectories, precursor trajectories, u, and delta_m
residualized_diagnostic.training: fit only on the 256 centered discovery positives
residualized_diagnostic.evaluation: evaluate once on all 610 centered validation and safety positives
permitted_features: response-position fraction and first four Fourier pairs

bases.writer: separate discovery-only weighted PCA per head, rank min(16, available rank)
bases.normal_state: discovery-only weighted PCA rank min(64, available rank)
bases.target: discovery-only weighted PCA rank min(128, available rank), with metrics reconstructed to original space

residualized_diagnostic.alpha_selection: maximize original-space centered R2 under leave-one-discovery-concept-out folds; ties choose larger alpha
baselines: zero centered prediction, equivalent to the frozen concept-decile oracle
the original uncentered full K12 and oracle results reported unchanged

metrics.within_R2_u: 1 - squared original-space centered prediction error / squared centered target energy
metrics.within_probe_vector_snmse: squared error of the standardized centered complete probe vector divided by centered target energy with 1e-6 floor

residualized_diagnostic.interpretation: descriptive falsification analysis only; no threshold can convert the original Gate 1 failure into a pass

cross_concept_diagnostic.outer_folds: leave exactly one of all 13 concepts out; no transform or hyperparameter sees its target outcomes
cross_concept_diagnostic.concept_writer_feature: per-head normalized K12 delta_Z averaged within ten response-position deciles; within each outer fold fit a separate rank min(2, training_concepts-1) PCA per head on training-concept summaries and flatten the coordinates
cross_concept_diagnostic.normal_state_feature: normal resid_post[8] averaged within response-position decile and projected by an outer-training-only rank min(4, training_concepts-1) PCA
cross_concept_diagnostic.semantic_feature_baseline: mean exact-precursor input-embedding-table vector for tokenizer tokens of the literal trigger_concept string with add_special_tokens=false; all fitting restricted to outer-training concepts
cross_concept_diagnostic.target_probe_vector: concept mean standardized 13-probe correct-trigger-minus-normal margin vector within ten response-position deciles, flattened in decile-major order
cross_concept_diagnostic.secondary_target_u: concept mean u within ten response-position deciles, projected by outer-training-only PCA rank min(4, training_concepts-1) per decile and reconstructed before metrics
cross_concept_diagnostic.alpha_selection: inner leave-one-training-concept-out probe-vector SNMSE; ties choose larger alpha
cross_concept_diagnostic.interpretation: triage only because all 13 concepts were previously inspected and the concept sample is small

phase_b.purpose: distinguish direct negative writing, gating or omission, downstream amplification, and a concept-dependent hybrid

absolute_contribution_operators.N_zero: in the normal target, replace every valid-response K12 raw pre-o_proj head slice by exact zeros and recompute each affected attention branch with target unselected heads and the actual shared RMS denominator
absolute_contribution_operators.T_zero: apply the identical zero operator in the correctly triggered target
absolute_contribution_operators.N_from_T: replace normal K12 slices by aligned correctly triggered slices
absolute_contribution_operators.T_from_N: replace correctly triggered K12 slices by aligned normal slices
absolute_contribution_operators.N_normal_concept_mean: replace normal K12 slices by the leave-one-example-out same-concept, same-label normal-state raw-head mean within response-position decile
absolute_contribution_operators.T_normal_concept_mean: install the same leave-one-example-out normal concept mean in the correctly triggered target
absolute_contribution_operators.mean_fallback: when a concept-label-decile donor cell is empty, use the discovery same-label global normal decile mean
paths: ordinary total effect with downstream recomputation

matched_random_controls.population: all 866 positive examples in both checkpoints; negative examples receive the selected real operation but not all 32 random draws
matched_random_controls.base_delta: paired natural K12 correct-trigger-minus-normal raw-head delta for the same example
matched_random_controls.operator: for each head and draw, right-multiply the token-by-256 delta by a deterministic Haar orthogonal 256-by-256 matrix and add to normal for induction or subtract from triggered for removal
invariants: per-head Frobenius-norm relative error at most 1e-6 before BF16 installation
per-head temporal-Gram relative Frobenius error at most 1e-5 before BF16 installation
every singular value above 1e-6 times the leading singular value is preserved within 1e-5 relative error before BF16 installation
same response mask and BF16 installation path as the selected operation
matched_random_controls.seed_derivation: PCG64 seed + 1000 * draw_index + frozen K12 head index; QR sign fixed by positive diagonal of R

natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.concept_gap_G: equal-example concept mean of own-probe margin(normal)-margin(correct_trigger) on positive examples
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.gap_failure_rule: retain and report the concept; mark its mechanism fraction uninterpretable and do not count it toward sign consistency
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.negative_write_fraction: mean own-probe margin(T_zero)-margin(T), divided by G
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.omission_fraction: mean own-probe margin(N)-margin(N_zero), divided by G
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.replacement_rescue_fraction: mean own-probe margin(T_from_N)-margin(T), divided by G
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.replacement_induction_fraction: mean own-probe margin(N)-margin(N_from_T), divided by G
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.total_replacement_effect: mean of the unnormalized directional rescue and induction effects
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.direct_replacement_effect: mean of the corresponding frozen-write directional effects
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.direct_fraction: direct_replacement_effect / total_replacement_effect with 0.1 absolute denominator floor
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.complete_probe_vector_recovery: one minus squared standardized distance between patched movement and the natural normal-minus-triggered vector divided by natural vector energy with 1e-6 floor; average rescue and induction
natural_gap_and_directional_metrics.aggregation: compute per example where defined, then equal examples and equal concepts; never pool tokens or concepts by count

downstream_frontier_mapping.source_operator: patch only the named selected-head layer group normal-to-triggered or triggered-to-normal at its raw pre-o_proj sites
downstream_frontier_mapping.later_branch_order: strict model execution order after the source branch: source-layer MLP, then each later full attention branch and MLP branch through block 12
downstream_frontier_mapping.direct_endpoint: freeze every later additive write to the target cache
downstream_frontier_mapping.total_endpoint: allow every later branch to recompute naturally
downstream_frontier_mapping.cumulative_frontiers: release the first j later branches in strict execution order and freeze every remaining later branch
downstream_frontier_mapping.single_branch_releases: release exactly one later branch and freeze all other later branches
downstream_frontier_mapping.released_attention_rule: a released later attention branch recomputes in full from its incoming residual with no selected-head clamp
downstream_frontier_mapping.unique_configuration_rule: for a source with n later branches, run direct F0, cumulative F1 through Fn where Fn is total, and single-branch Bj for j=2 through n; B1 is identical to F1 and is not duplicated
downstream_frontier_mapping.discovery_screen: on all 256 discovery positives in the Chameleon only, run every unique configuration for every selected source group and its same-layer count-matched nonselected source control in both directions
downstream_frontier_mapping.selected_frontier_rule: on discovery positives choose the source-group/frontier pair with largest equal-concept own-probe remainder recovery; ties choose fewer released branches, then earlier source layer, then lexical frontier ID
downstream_frontier_mapping.heldout_evaluation: on all 610 validation and safety positives in both checkpoints, run direct, the frozen selected frontier, and total for the selected source group and its matched nonselected source in both directions
downstream_frontier_mapping.negative_evaluation: run the identical direct, selected-frontier, and total matrix on all 866 negatives in both checkpoints
downstream_frontier_mapping.remainder_recovery: (frontier directional effect-direct directional effect)/(total directional effect-direct directional effect) with 0.1 absolute denominator floor
downstream_frontier_mapping.matched_control: same-layer count-matched nonselected source heads under the identical release frontier

attention_operation.population: all discovery positives for Chameleon-only site selection; all validation and safety positives plus all negatives for evaluation at the frozen site in both checkpoints
attention_operation.heads: every K12 head individually and the four frozen layer groups
attention_operation.pattern_patch_values_retained: replace the selected head's post-softmax attention pattern source-to-target while retaining target V states; preserve the target causal mask and renormalize only if numerical masking requires it
attention_operation.value_patch_pattern_retained: replace selected source-token V states source-to-target while retaining the target QK pattern
attention_operation.concept_span_qk: patch Q and K rows/columns whose tokenizer offset spans overlap the literal trigger_concept in the monitoring prefix
attention_operation.concept_span_ov: patch V states at those concept-span tokens while retaining target pattern

token_source_masks.concept_span: prefix tokenizer offsets overlapping the literal trigger_concept substring
token_source_masks.monitoring_language: all other nonspecial tokens in the monitoring prefix
token_source_masks.original_prompt: tokens aligned to original user content p
token_source_masks.template_or_punctuation: remaining prompt-side special, template, and punctuation tokens
token_source_masks.previous_response: valid response tokens strictly before the current response query position

attention_operation.discovery_screen: run all 16 sites by four operation families by two directions by two paths on all 256 discovery positives in the Chameleon
attention_operation.site_selection_rule: for each site take its largest equal-concept complete probe-vector recovery among the four operation families; select the site with the largest value; ties choose fewer heads, then earlier layer, then lexical site ID
attention_operation.heldout_evaluation: at the frozen site run all four operation families, both directions, and both paths on all 610 validation and safety positives in both checkpoints
attention_operation.negative_evaluation: run the identical frozen-site matrix on all 866 negatives in both checkpoints
primary_metrics: fraction of full selected-head directional own-probe effect
attention_operation.interpretation: attention allocation is accounting only; causal operation labels require these interventions

direct_reconfiguration.rule: both negative_write_fraction and omission_fraction pass base_zero_signature while neither directional advantage gate passes

hybrid.rule: direct_monitor_writing and downstream_amplification both pass, with subtype determined by negative_writing, omission, or direct_reconfiguration
hybrid.fresh_requirement: any concept strata or subtype predictors must be frozen before fresh confirmation

sign_consistency.safety_rule: deception and harmfulness are always reported separately and neither may show a statistically supported opposite-direction effect for a population-wide claim

inference.confidence_bounds: one-sided percentile bounds for frozen gates; two-sided percentile intervals for reports
inference.bootstrap_unit: resample concepts with replacement and paired examples with replacement within selected concepts; preserve every paired condition and intervention row
inference.determinism: numpy PCG64 via numpy.random.default_rng with listed seed derivations
inference.multiple_reporting: all gates are conjunctive decision clauses rather than null-hypothesis tests; no selective p-value gate is used

numerical_contract.cached_execution_rule: a cache optimization is allowed only after exact real-checkpoint equality under the final batch and kernel shape; failed attempts are preserved
numerical_contract.failure_rule: any required valid token, probe, identity, dtype, response-ID, or hook-cleanup failure blocks scientific interpretation until fixed under a newly committed implementation

frontier_discovery_rows.formula: 256 positives * 32 unique source/configuration cells across four source groups * 2 selected-or-nonselected sources * 2 directions * 1 Chameleon checkpoint

frontier_heldout_rows.formula: 610 positives * 3 direct-selected-total configurations * 2 selected-or-nonselected sources * 2 directions * 2 checkpoints

frontier_negative_rows.formula: 866 negatives * 3 direct-selected-total configurations * 2 selected-or-nonselected sources * 2 directions * 2 checkpoints

attention_discovery_rows.formula: 256 positives * 16 sites * 4 operation families * 2 directions * 2 paths * 1 Chameleon checkpoint

attention_heldout_rows.formula: 610 positives * 1 frozen site * 4 operation families * 2 directions * 2 paths * 2 checkpoints

attention_negative_rows.formula: 866 negatives * 1 frozen site * 4 operation families * 2 directions * 2 paths * 2 checkpoints

expected_execution_matrix.counting_rule: one row contains all 13 raw margins and sequence scores for one example, checkpoint, operator/configuration, direction where applicable, and path; natural endpoints, accounting audits, features, and preflight attempts are separate

required: every pinned input hash and population count matches
the sealed Gate 1 audit remains unchanged and failed scientifically
all K12 and nonselected component identities resolve uniquely and remain disjoint
Phase A centering excludes the target example and every fitted transform obeys its fold boundary
cross-concept outer folds expose no held-out target outcome to preprocessing, PCA, alpha selection, or baselines
zero, mean, source replacement, target identity, and random operators pass synthetic tests
target-state replacement is exact under the final real-checkpoint batch shape
Haar controls satisfy every frozen rank, norm, and temporal-Gram invariant
progressive branch releases recompute only declared branches and freeze all others
QK, pattern, V, and OV interventions affect only declared heads, source tokens, and response queries
response token IDs and masks remain identical in every paired run
all hooks are removed after every batch
every expected row, concept, label, direction, path, frontier, and control draw is present exactly once
all raw artifacts carry one committed execution identity
two reducer runs from one committed analysis implementation are byte-identical
implementation_gate.interpretation: implementation failure blocks all Phase A-B scientific interpretation and is neither a mechanism pass nor fail

scientific_continue_gate.natural_phenomenon: at least 7 of 9 heldout positive concepts have G >= 0.1; all nine remain reported
scientific_continue_gate.operation: at least one of negative_writing, omission, direct_reconfiguration, downstream_amplification, or a frozen hybrid passes every clause assigned to it on the primary heldout population
scientific_continue_gate.direct_or_frontier_requirement: the selected account passes direct_monitor_writing, downstream_amplification, or both
scientific_continue_gate.specificity: random and exact-precursor control_weakness clauses pass
scientific_continue_gate.pass: all preconditions and clauses above pass after the operation/frontier is selected only on discovery
scientific_continue_gate.fail: any required clause fails or no stable causal operation is selected
scientific_continue_gate.pass_consequence: Phase C contract drafting is permitted but Phase C execution is not automatically authorized
scientific_continue_gate.fail_consequence: stop the new mechanism program and retain the sealed causal-localization fallback
prohibited_adjustments: change a threshold after an outcome
drop or replace a concept or example
select a frontier on validation or safety outcomes
add or remove a mechanism class after outcomes
change the zero, mean, direct-path, release, random, QK, or OV operator after outcomes without a new failure decision and complete rerun
treat Phase A-B development evidence as fresh confirmation
begin Phase C after a failed continue gate

no_release_boundary: no push, tag, release, submission, upload, external message, or author contact is authorized
